attempts.text: MATCH (a:Issue)-[l]->(b:Issue) WHERE type(l)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND exists((a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()) AND exists((b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()) MATCH (a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p),(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q) RETURN count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN p<>q THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff

MATCH path=(a:Issue)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(r IN relationships(path) WHERE exists{(startNode(r))-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p) MATCH (endNode(r))-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q) WHERE p<>q}) AND size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(path)))=size(nodes(path)) RETURN count(*) AS n

MATCH path=(a:Issue) ((x)-[r:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]->(y:Issue) WHERE EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(y)} = false AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()} AND EXISTS{(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()}){1,5} (b:Issue) RETURN count(*) AS n

MATCH path=(a:Issue) ((x)-[r:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]->(y:Issue) WHERE EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(y)} = false AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()} AND EXISTS{(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()}){1,5} (b:Issue)
WITH path, [n IN nodes(path) | n.issueKey] AS path_ids, relationships(path) AS rels
WHERE size(apoc.coll.toSet(path_ids))=size(path_ids)
RETURN path_ids AS path, [n IN nodes(path) | head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p)|p.personKey])] AS people, [n IN nodes(path) | head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p)|p.projectKey])] AS projects, [r IN rels | r.linkId] AS links

MATCH path=(a:Issue) ((x)-[r:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]->(y:Issue) WHERE EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(y)} = false AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()} AND EXISTS{(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()}){1,5} (b:Issue)
WITH path, [n IN nodes(path) | n.issueKey] AS path_ids, relationships(path) AS rels
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(path_ids)-1) WHERE NOT path_ids[i] IN path_ids[i+1..])
RETURN path_ids AS path, [n IN nodes(path) | head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p)|p.personKey])] AS people, [n IN nodes(path) | head([(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p)|p.projectKey])] AS projects, [r IN rels | r.linkId] AS links

MATCH path=(a:Issue) ((x)-[r:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]->(y:Issue) WHERE EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(p)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(y)} = false AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()} AND EXISTS{(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->()}){1,5} (b:Issue)
WITH path, [n IN nodes(path) | n.issueKey] AS path_ids, relationships(path) AS rels
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(path_ids)-1) WHERE NOT path_ids[i] IN path_ids[i+1..])
RETURN path_ids AS path, [r IN rels | r.linkId] AS links, [r IN rels | type(r)] AS types, [n IN nodes(path)[1..] | n.issueKey] AS issues
